title: 第484章 不吃激将云抱剑第483章 一老一小交际花
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
第484章“不吃激将”云抱剑
风慈也吩咐风氏随行：“守规矩。”
她说这话时，特意看了风湖一眼。
风湖脸色更难看，却到底没开口。
各家小辈自然是欣然领命，纷纷落向云海之下。
倒是青莲剑宗副宗主青霄剑尊一人一剑，快意潇洒，并没有怕弟子闹事的苦恼。
“诸位前辈，请。”
云擎侧身抬手，引向揽云巅方向。云渊上前熟稔的与众位老友寒暄，一行法架便笑笑闹闹的往揽云巅而去了。
姜守拙拎着酒壶，杵了杵云渊。
“诶老家伙，我可给你带了好酒。”
云渊哼笑：“什么你的酒，那酒到了云氏，就是我云氏的酒。”
姜守拙：“……好你个土匪。”
玄微真人摇头叹息。
“果然千年不改。”
云擎乖巧跟在二长老身侧，当个老人家随身的吉祥物，毕竟在这一堆仙尊境老黄瓜里，他还太嫩。
倒是姜守拙和云渊扯皮完回头看他，笑意更深。
“云擎小友，较之昔日大周仙朝一会，如今气象，可是大大不同了。”
这话一出，几方目光皆落在云擎身上，大都带着长辈看晚辈时的温和欣赏。
云擎垂眸浅笑：
“姜老谬赞，不过是晚辈侥幸略有所得罢了。”

姜守拙笑得更开心了，他怼了怼身旁的玄微真人：
“诶玄微你听，他们云氏的人说侥幸，谁敢当真。”
云渊摸了摸下巴，“你小子这话倒是没错。”
云擎：“……”
二长老，您究竟是哪边的？
一旁众人闻言皆是莞尔。
玄微真人道：“可惜石年尚在神山闭关，不然你们年轻人多见见，互相切磋论道，也是美事。”
他正是姜石年的师尊。
风氏左长老风慈也温和道：“云大公子年少有成，灵儿亦是对你多有夸赞，天元年轻一辈有此人物，是幸事。”
“风长老谬赞。”云擎笑着拱手。
风慈微笑颔首，人如其名，确实颇为慈和，半点没有大能者的架子，给人的感觉便如邻家奶奶一般。
倒是他身边的风湖，脸色仍有些不好看。
云擎放手的动作不明显的一顿，侧眸不经意扫向对方。
他总感觉对方一瞬间隐约泄出的冷意，似乎是冲着他来的？
云擎心中微动。
敌意？可他与风湖并无交集。
风氏中，他所相熟的也不过风灵儿一人，其他有交集的，也就左长老风慈，以及当初九霄青云榜上碰见的几个风氏弟子了。
云擎将风湖的细微反应尽数收入眼底，面上却不显。
不过风湖虽然为人倨傲自负了些，但仙尊境巅峰的实力可是实打实的，按理并非如此容易就被人窥见心绪。
但还是那句话，不巧，云大公子这不是突破了嘛。
content_en:
Chapter 484 "Don't eat aggressive generals" Yun Baojian
Feng Ci also ordered Feng to accompany him: "obey the rules."
When she said this, she glanced at Feng Hu specifically.
Feng Hu's face turned even more ugly, but he didn't speak.
The juniors from each family naturally accepted the order happily and fell under the sea of ​​clouds one after another.
On the other hand, Qingxiao Sword Master, the deputy master of the Qinglian Sword Sect, has one sword per man, and he is happy and unrestrained. He is not worried about his disciples making trouble.
"Seniors, please."
Yun Qing turned sideways and raised his hand, leading him in the direction of Lan Yundian. Yun Yuan stepped forward to greet all his old friends in a familiar manner, and then headed towards Lan Yun Dian with a smile and a row of tricks.
Jiang Shouzhuo picked up the wine pot and poured it into Yunyuan.
"Hey old guy, I brought you some good wine."
Yun Yuan laughed: "What about your wine? When the wine reaches Yun's family, it will be my Yun's wine."
Jiang Shouzhuo: "...you are such a bandit."
Master Xuanwei shook his head and sighed.
"Sure enough, it will never change after a thousand years."
Yun Qing followed the second elder obediently, acting as a mascot for the old man. After all, he was still too young among these old cucumbers in the Immortal Realm.
Jiang Shouzhuo, on the other hand, turned back to look at him after arguing with Yunyuan, his smile even deeper.
"Little friend Yun Qing, compared to the days of the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty in the past, the weather today is very different."
As soon as these words came out, several eyes fell on Yun Qing, most of them with the gentle appreciation that elders look at juniors.
Yun Qing lowered his eyes and smiled:
"Jiang Lao Miaozan, it's just a small fortune for this junior."
Jiang Shouzhuo smiled even more happily, and he said to Master Xuanwei beside him:
"Hey Xuanwei, listen, people from the Yun family say it's a fluke, who dares to take it seriously?"
Yunyuan touched his chin, "What you said is correct, kid."
Yun Qing: "..."
Second Elder, which side are you from?
Everyone on the side smiled when they heard this.
Master Xuanwei said: "It's a pity that Shi Nian is still in seclusion in the sacred mountain. Otherwise, it would be a good thing for you young people to meet more and learn from each other."
He is Jiang Shinian's master.
Feng Ci, the left elder of the Feng clan, also said gently: "Master Yun is very successful at a young age, and Ling'er also praises you a lot. It is a blessing for the younger generation of Tianyuan to have such a person."
"Elder Feng is so complimentary." Yun Qing smiled and cupped his hands.
Feng Ci smiled and nodded. As her name suggests, she is indeed quite kind. She doesn't have the airs of a powerful person at all. She feels like the grandmother next door.
On the other hand, Feng Hu, who was beside him, still looked a little unhappy.
Yun Qing let go without any obvious movement, and glanced sideways at the other party inadvertently.
He always felt that the coldness that was vaguely released from the other party for a moment seemed to be directed at him?
Yun Qing's heart moved slightly.
hostility? But he has no intersection with Feng Hu.
Among the Feng Clan, he was only familiar with one person, Feng Ling'er. The others he knew well were Elder Zuo Feng Ci and several Feng Clan disciples he met on the Nine Heavens Qingyun Ranking.
Yun Qing took in all Feng Hu's subtle reactions, but didn't show them on his face.
However, although Feng Hu is a bit arrogant and arrogant, his strength at the peak of the Immortal Realm is real, and it should not be so easy for others to peek into his mind.
But again, unfortunately, Master Yun has made a breakthrough.
